model_output.rationale: 835 shows OA-22 on all three lines with MOA MA04. 271 for DOS 2026-01-27 shows EB*R naming "NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS" with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." Claim was filed to Keystone as primary (SBR*P, CLM05-3=1). Medicare is the true primary; Keystone cannot adjudicate as secondary without Medicare's EOB. Bill Medicare first, then resubmit to Keystone as secondary with adjudication data.

root_cause.explanation: Claim filed to Keystone as primary but 271 confirms Medicare Part B (Novitas) is primary payer. OA-22 + MA04 on all lines; no Medicare adjudication data was available to include.

next_action.detail: Bill Medicare Part B (Novitas, payer ID 1846349352) as primary for DOS 2026-01-27. Once Medicare adjudicates, resubmit to Keystone as secondary with SBR01=S and Medicare's payment/adjustment data in loops 2320/2430.
